verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity and cap-table platform, so an investor portal is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions investor-facing portal views of holdings or structured investor updates. The closest items do not qualify: employee trading participant views, team-member permission segmentation, and a cap-table API are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an investor portal.

support.subject: As a founder, my investors get their own portal view of their holdings and can receive structured updates without emailing me for the cap table
